burglary_commercial_calibration.denominator_formula: households_total + k_destination_poi * destination_poi_total + k_retail_jobs * lodes_retail_jobs + k_industrial_jobs * (lodes_manufacturing_jobs + lodes_wholesale_jobs + lodes_transport_warehouse_jobs)

fold_safe.criterion: per-held-out-burglary-city NNLS on all other calibration cities

single_term_comparison.comparison_basis: same calibration rows as four-term NNLS

burglary_commercial_calibration.source_year_pooling: sum incident_count over all source-year block-group rows before NNLS

burglary_commercial_gradient_block_group.quintile_basis: commercial_premises_total / (households_total + commercial_premises_total) over published burglary rows
burglary_commercial_gradient_block_group.regime_policy: direct_city_incident rows are direct; mixed and other rows are evaluated as modeled_transfer

thresholds.rationale: catch consolidated city-county agencies at 2.6x+ without tripping current growth-staleness cases
